body_lead: BENGALURU: To expand access to emerging technologies and enhance employability among youth in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities and towns across Karnataka, the state has approved setting up of 50 Artificial Intelligence (AI) laboratories in government colleges across the state. Selected colleges will be equipped with AI-enabled laboratory infrastructure that will support practical learning, experimentation, skill development and innovation.
